metadata.title: Code for "Microbial driver of 2006 – 2023 CH4 growth indicated by trends in atmospheric 𝛿D-CH4 and 𝛿13C-CH4", PNAS (in review)
metadata.description:
This repository contains the Python package used in the manuscript entitled
“Microbial driver of 2006–2023 CH₄ growth indicated by trends in atmospheric δD-CH₄ and δ¹³C-CH₄”,
which is in review at PNAS at the time of this code release.

The package calculates global mean δD-CH₄ and its uncertainty (in the .zip file Riddell-Young_2025_dD_GlobMean),
and conducts box model analyses to estimate global annual CH₄ emissions by category and associated uncertainty
(in the .zip file Riddell-Young_2025_MassBalancePackage).

The package also generates Figures 1–4 in the manuscript and related supplementary figures.

Required software

  • Python 3.11 or compatible
  • Spyder v5.4.3 (recommended IDE)
  • Common dependencies: numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scipy, xarray, cartopy, shapely, geopandas

Expected runtime

The full package runs in approximately 1 hour or less on a standard desktop machine.

Workflow

Folder: Riddell-Young_2025_dD_GlobMean

Run scripts in the following order:

  1. MBL_Calc_unc.py – pulls from Ccg_filter.py; produces smoothed data curves and uncertainty files for each dataset.
  2. dD_globmean_new.py – computes global annual mean δD-CH₄ and uncertainty for use in mass balance error propagation.

Folder: Riddell-Young_2025_MassBalancePackage

Run scripts in the following order:

  1. Mic_d13C.py – computes global annual mean microbial emission δ¹³C-CH₄ and uncertainty.
  2. BB_d13C.py – computes global annual mean biomass burning emission δ¹³C-CH₄ and uncertainty.
  3. Mic-BB-dD_Map_New.py – creates gridded maps for biomass burning and microbial δD-CH₄, and calculates their global annual means and uncertainties.
  4. Mic_dD.py – calculates global annual mean microbial emission δD-CH₄ and uncertainty.
  5. FF_dD_map_EDGAR.py – creates coal and oil/natural gas emission δD-CH₄ gridded maps.
  6. FF_dD_GlobMean.py – creates global annual mean time series of fossil fuel δD-CH₄ and uncertainty.
  7. FF_d13C_map_EDGAR.py – creates coal and oil/natural gas emission δ¹³C-CH₄ gridded maps.
  8. FF_d13C_GlobMean.py – creates global annual mean time series of fossil fuel δ¹³C-CH₄ and uncertainty.
  9. global_mean_plot.py – generates Figure 1 of the manuscript.
  10. dD_MassBalance.py – runs the global δD-CH₄ mass balance and calculates fossil fuel and microbial emissions and uncertainties. Sensitivity test parameters can be modified within the script.
  11. d13C_MassBalance.py – runs the global δ¹³C-CH₄ mass balance and calculates fossil fuel and microbial emissions and uncertainties. Sensitivity test parameters can be modified within the script.
  12. histogram_statistics.py – plots the mass balance results (Figure 3 of the main text).
  13. MassBalance_Plot.py – plots the mass balance results (Figure 2 of the main text).
  14. Fugitive_Emission_Rate.py – calculates methane intensity results and uncertainty (Figure 4 of the main text).

Notes

  • Script order matters for data dependencies; follow the workflow above.
  • Figures and outputs are written to subfolders automatically.
  • All file paths assume the repository’s root directory structure.
